about: Differences the parity suite EXPECTS rather than flags. Each entry is a BOUND, not an exemption: the test fails if the field comes back into agreement (the entry is stale — delete it) and fails if the difference grows past what the stated cause can account for. `scenario: "*"` means the difference is a property of the code rather than of the case. `maxRelative` is the measured difference rounded up to one significant figure.

divergences.cause: numVC: openisd's Driver#derive() autofills numVC = 1 for a record that omits it, so slot 23 reads C (the app supplied it). WinISD pins that slot E, asserting a human entered a value nobody typed. Ruled 2026-08-13 'there was a winisd bug here - obviously dont replicate that', so a red row here would be the suite being wrong, not the app.

packages/engine/src/air.ts winisdAir() scales the frozen RHO/C pair by tempK (rho ∝ 1/T, c ∝ √T) instead of returning them unconditionally. WinISD's own compatibility air is a fixed pair that does not move with temperature at all — env-t-303's c/roo are byte-identical to its 293.15 K twin env-rh-30. This is a calculation-logic change gated on human authorisation (AGENTS.md 'Calculation logic — permission gate'); not fixed here.
Same mechanism as air.c: winisdAir() scales rho by T_REF_K/tempK; WinISD's frozen compatibility air does not scale rho with temperature at all. Same permission gate, same fix, same bug file.
